missedEssential.fact: Costs are not compared across dialects because MariaDB's and MySQL's identically-named `cost` field disagree by three orders of magnitude for a comparable scan (F17).
`estimatedRowsRead` is absent on SQLite because SQLite reports no estimate at all.
SQLite has no single EXPLAIN blob, so the SQLite parser reconstructs `raw` as one line per row in the same id/parent/notused/detail shape it received.
ScanEstimate represents every scan/read-type PlanNode a dialect's parser found together with its row estimate, of which D14's `estimatedRowsRead` is the max.
